longHistory.sampling: heap and DOM are sampled after initial render; heapAfterScroll after 60 scripted scroll frames. No forced GC; these are not steady-state RSS measurements.

storageFaultModule.note: Test-only module built from these exact sources; GUI bundle identity is recorded separately.

limitations: All histories and identities are generated test data, not native Codex execution.
Fixtures enter through the real main/preload event; credentials and Gateway handshake are not simulated as successes.
Network guard attaches after launch; the Profile starts empty and product policy also blocks renderer networking.
Playwright debugger loopback endpoints are automation plumbing, not a test Gateway.
Scripted composition events exercise IME guards; physical input method acceptance requires the separate Computer Use check.
Native appearance recovery invokes the real menu handler programmatically; CDP bypasses Electron before-input-event, so physical Ctrl+Shift+0 is a separate check.
No TLS/public network, production service changes, DEB or release work.

archive.sanitization: Generated fixture identities and test action data only. Screenshots copied byte-for-byte from the latest passing result manifest; filenames made repository-relative. No private profile, credentials, native user history, or previous failure artifacts included.

storageModuleProvenance.evidence: performance.storageFaultModule records exact source SHA-256 for local-data.ts/types.ts and the compiled test-only module. These source hashes were independently checked again before archival. GUI build provenance remains separate in source/manifestHash.

performanceSampling.evidence: Performance collection is enabled before initial render. performance.longHistory contains render/scroll LayoutDuration and RecalcStyleDuration deltas, initial heap, heapAfterScroll, and an explicit no-GC/non-RSS sampling caveat.

blockedUpgradePreservation.evidence: IndexedDB: real blocked upgrade aborts late migration and preserves original version and records
blockedUpgradePreservation.assertions: The executed harness creates a version-1 database and writes a sentinel, provokes a blocked version-2 open, then verifies version remains 1 and the original sentinel record is unchanged after the late upgrade is cancelled.
